source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique common TBD identity; OOB counterpart defines standard App 0x06/0x4F payload-version read.

source_snapshot.procedure: During Test TBD; generic pre-step requests configuration verification and log clearing.

historical_reviews.related_source_cases: OOB counterpart makes the standard 0x4F read FULLY AUTOMATABLE after inputs.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 makes expected version and scope Project inputs; ED-38 no retry.

original_test_intent: Read the version advertised for one approved channel payload and compare it with the product compatibility baseline without activation or update.
original_method: Use protected App 0x06/0x4F with a validated channel/payload selector, pinned version decoder and approved compatibility reference.
manual_activity: Engineer supplies the payload identity and version reference once; the bounded read needs no action confirmation.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Too conservative after the paired standard OOB history is considered.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Protected raw App 0x06/0x4F or equivalent read-only API with pinned version parser.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Read one scoped payload version, validate identity/encoding, compare the signed compatibility reference, record health and prove no payload/channel mutation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact read-only Review guidance without editing Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Version identity only; it does not validate payload operation, image regions, signature or update behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong selector or decoder can drive unsafe compatibility/update decisions.

project_override_considerations: Vendor inventory API is equivalent only if it binds the same channel/payload identity and version semantics.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master is TBD and requests log clearing; GPT V2 permanently blocks a standard 0x4F read because Project schema/reference inputs are missing.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The 0x4F operation is defined; selector, decoder and compatibility baseline are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Separates version inventory from activation/update coverage and makes the identity binding explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is a deterministic non-mutating version query. With a validated payload selector, decoder and reference it is safely automated; no firmware or payload action is implied by a matching version.
